title: Joy Comes with the Morning

questions.question: I will extol you, O Lord, for you have drawn me up and have not let my foes rejoice over whom?
questions.explanation: Psalm 30:1 (ESV): "I will extol you, O Lord, for you have drawn me up and have not let my foes rejoice over me."

questions.question: O Lord my God, I cried to you for help, and you have what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 30:2 (ESV): "O Lord my God, I cried to you for help, and you have healed me."

questions.question: O Lord, you have brought up my soul from where?
questions.explanation: Psalm 30:3 (ESV): "O Lord, you have brought up my soul from Sheol;"

questions.question: Sing praises to the Lord, O you his saints, and give thanks to his holy what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 30:4 (ESV): "...and give thanks to his holy name." (Footnote: Or his holy memorial name)

questions.question: For his anger is but for a moment, and his favor is for a what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 30:5 (ESV): "For his anger is but for a moment, and his favor is for a lifetime."

questions.question: Weeping may tarry for the night, but joy comes with the what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 30:5 (ESV): "Weeping may tarry for the night, but joy comes with the morning."

questions.question: As for me, I said in my prosperity, "I shall never be what?"
questions.explanation: Psalm 30:6 (ESV): "As for me, I said in my prosperity, 'I shall never be moved.'"

questions.question: By your favor, O Lord, you made my mountain stand strong; you hid your face; I was what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 30:7 (ESV): "...you hid your face; I was dismayed."

questions.question: To you, O Lord, I cry, and to the Lord I plead for what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 30:8 (ESV): "To you, O Lord, I cry, and to the Lord I plead for mercy:"

questions.question: What profit is there in my death, if I go down to the pit? Will the dust praise you? Will it tell of your what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 30:9 (ESV): "...Will the dust praise you? Will it tell of your faithfulness?"

questions.question: You have turned for me my mourning into what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 30:11 (ESV): "You have turned for me my mourning into dancing;"

questions.question: You have loosed my sackcloth and clothed me with what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 30:11 (ESV): "...you have loosed my sackcloth and clothed me with gladness,"

questions.question: That my glory may sing your praise and not be what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 30:12 (ESV): "that my glory may sing your praise and not be silent."

questions.question: O Lord my God, I will give thanks to you when?
questions.explanation: Psalm 30:12 (ESV): "O Lord my God, I will give thanks to you forever."

questions.question: What is the title of Psalm 30?
options: A Song at the Dedication of the Temple
questions.correctAnswer: A Song at the Dedication of the Temple
questions.explanation: Psalm 30 Title: "A Psalm of David. A Song at the dedication of the temple."

key_verse_text: For his anger is but for a moment, and his favor is for a lifetime. Weeping may tarry for the night, but joy comes with the morning.
